bullets.text: Gigabit IQ Crowdfunding Success - **Gigabit IQ** aims to raise £270,000 for expansion, with £243,650 already committed.
Cisco's New Partner Program - **Cisco** launches the 360 Partner Program to enhance AI readiness among telecom operators.
NCSC Cybersecurity Alert - **NCSC** warns of Russian DDoS attacks targeting UK critical infrastructure.
Intracom and Nova Collaboration - **Intracom Telecom** partners with **Nova** to enhance enterprise connectivity via 5G.
TalkTalk's Strategic Sale - **TalkTalk** seeks buyers for its consumer ISP and wholesale platform amid market interest.
AI Infrastructure Investment - Telecom operators are increasingly investing in AI infrastructure to meet rising demands.
Open Cosmos Satellite Launch - **Open Cosmos** successfully launches its first satellites for a new LEO telecom constellation.
5G Broadcast Demonstration - **Rohde & Schwarz**, **Qualcomm**, and **Motorola** showcase live 5G Broadcast in Brazil.
Regulatory Challenges in Europe - **GSMA** warns that regulatory proposals may hinder Europe's digital infrastructure ambitions.
NEC's 5G Radio Launch - **NEC** prepares to launch a new 5G massive MIMO radio unit, enhancing network efficiency.
